new_entities.name: Levothyroxine taken in the evening
new_entities.description: Taking levothyroxine at bedtime or in the evening instead of before breakfast.

new_entities.name: TSH optimization
new_entities.description: Achievement and maintenance of target thyroid-stimulating hormone control during levothyroxine replacement.

edges.effect_quant: Adult crossover trials reported lower TSH with bedtime dosing, including a direct treatment effect of -1.25 mIU/L in one 90-patient trial, but pediatric randomized data found no meaningful difference versus early morning administration.
edges.population: children and adults with primary hypothyroidism on stable oral levothyroxine replacement
edges.mechanism: Bedtime dosing may improve absorption because the stomach has been empty longer and there are fewer immediate food-drug interactions, but this advantage depends on actual spacing from dinner and bedtime habits.
edges.summary: Evening levothyroxine dosing can match or sometimes modestly improve TSH control compared with morning dosing, but the literature is not fully uniform across ages and study designs. It is a reasonable alternative rather than a universally superior regimen.
edges.caveats: Benefits are most apparent in adult crossover studies with careful timing away from food. Real-world evening routines vary, and pediatric data suggest equivalence rather than clear superiority, so the overall edge is mixed.

evidence.citation: Bolk N et al 2010 Arch Intern Med
evidence.notes: Effects of evening vs morning levothyroxine intake: a randomized double-blind crossover trial.

effect_quant.comparator: direct treatment effect on TSH with bedtime versus morning intake

evidence.citation: Srivastava T et al 2018 J Assoc Physicians India
evidence.notes: A Crossover Study Evaluating Effect of Timing of Levothyroxine on Thyroid Hormone Status in Patients of Hypothyroidism.

effect_quant.comparator: TSH reduction in the bedtime-first sequence from baseline 2.63 to 1.85 mIU/L at 6 weeks

evidence.citation: Navid A et al 2021 Pediatr Endocrinol Diabetes Metab
evidence.notes: Comparative efficacy of early morning versus bedtime administration of levothyroxine in children with hypothyroidism: a prospective, open label, randomized, case-control study.
